title: Permutation of input indices
statement: For natural numbers $m,n$ and an index $v$, define a new index by sending $v$ to $n+v$ if $v<m$, to $v-m$ if $m\le v<m+n$, and leaving it equal to $v$ if $v\ge m+n$.
